introduction: Minnesota’s Working Family Credit is a refundable income-tax credit for eligible workers with income below the applicable limit.
description: Minnesota’s Working Family Credit is a refundable income-tax credit for eligible workers with income below the applicable limit.

sections.who: Check Schedule M1CWFC. Full-year nonresidents and another person’s dependents are excluded; other restrictions apply.
sections.get: The credit can increase a refund even when no tax is due. It is calculated with the child-related credits on M1CWFC.
sections.docs:
• Earned-income records.
  • Filing-status and dependent details.
  • Residency records for part-year allocation.
sections.apply:
1. Read the current rules

    Visit Revenue’s Working Family Credit page.

  2. Calculate the credit

    Complete the correct tax year’s M1CWFC and any required M1NR allocation.

  3. File Minnesota taxes

    Include the schedules with the state return.
sections.after: Keep the filed return and schedules. Government debts can offset a refund.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Working Family Credit eligibility and filing. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
